nport.note: Form N-PORT is filed by the trust Professionally Managed Portfolios once per series, so only the primary document names the series; the ETF has a new series ID (S000098509) since the February 2026 reorganisation of the mutual fund series S000081831. Only the report for the last month of each fiscal quarter (year end 30 Jun: 31 Mar, 30 Jun, 30 Sep, 31 Dec) becomes public, and it is public on EDGAR as soon as the trust files it, which must be within 60 days after that quarter end. Verified 4 Sep 2026 against data.sec.gov and the filing's primary_doc.xml: accession 0001193125-26-360389, filed 21 Aug 2026, report period 30 Jun 2026, series S000098509 'Pabrai Wagons ETF', 19 positions.

_namesNote: kap = the company’s page on KAP, Turkey’s Public Disclosure Platform (oid: page id; code: the Borsa Istanbul code), read by the build for the >5 % shareholder table that names Pabrai’s private funds. sec13f.reportable says whether the security is on SEC's Official List of Section 13(f) Securities as far as known (US-listed shares and ADSs are; shares listed only abroad and money-market funds are not). When false, absence from Dalal Street's 13F is structural and says nothing about whether Dalal Street holds it.
